title: Unwrap: Chat Analyzer & Coach
shortDescription: Chat report card, fun cards and an AI coach. Your chats stay on your phone.
fullDescription:
Who texts first? Who’s really into it? Who replies “Ok.” with a period? 👀

Unwrap turns an exported WhatsApp or Telegram chat into a funny chat report card and shareable stat cards. With Unwrap Pro you also get an AI report where every insight comes with receipts: a real quote from your chat, timestamp included.

📒 FREE TO START
🏅 Chat report card: interest, reply speed, humor and drama, graded for both of you
💬 Who texts first, who writes more, who replies faster
⏱️ Average reply time, longest silence, double texts, night owl score
😂 How many times you laughed together and how many days you’ve been talking
📊 Your own profile stats: favorite emoji, your word, your busiest hour
📤 Story cards made for sharing with friends

✨ UNWRAP PRO
🔍 Evidence-backed AI report: every comment comes with a real message from your chat
🤥 “Who lies more?”, 💘 “Who’s the romantic one?”, 🙄 passive-aggressive texts
🔥 Desire meter and 🕵️ manipulation radar
🧑‍🏫 AI report card with a teacher’s note
💬 Mila, your AI coach: ask “Are they into me?” or get reply ideas made for your chat
🎭 Roleplay: Mila can play your partner, your crush or your ex so you can rehearse that talk
🏆 Badges and titles, plus 💞 couple and bestie frames for your profile photo

🔒 YOUR CHATS STAY ON YOUR PHONE
Your chats are stored only on your phone, and the stats are calculated right there. For the Pro AI report, only selected messages are sent, with personal details like phone numbers, emails and IBANs masked, and they are not stored. You can delete all analyses at any time.

🚫 NO ADS. NO TOKENS.
No ads, no coins, no paying per report. One honest subscription unlocks everything.

HOW IT WORKS
1️⃣ In WhatsApp, open a chat, tap Export chat and share it to Unwrap. Or pick a saved .zip / .txt file or a Telegram .json export.
2️⃣ Choose which one is you and who this person is: partner, friend, family or group.
3️⃣ Your cards are ready in seconds. Share the funniest ones.

Works for chats with your partner, crush, best friend or family, and for group chats too.

Unwrap is free to download and the stat cards are free. Unwrap Pro is an auto-renewing subscription (monthly or yearly) with a 7-day free trial. Cancel any time in Google Play; if you cancel before the trial ends, you won’t be charged.

AI insights are estimates, not verdicts. The lie, manipulation and desire cards are just for fun.
Unwrap is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Telegram.
